name: WordsOnline Drupal Connector
description: A TMGMT translator that connects to the WordsOnline translation service.
project_description:
Overview 

The WordsOnline Connector for Drupal Translation Management Tool (TMGMT) allows users to send content directly from Drupal sites to the WordsOnline Translation Services for professional translation, without leaving the Drupal environment.

This is an external, fast, and professional translation service for the Drupal TMGMT module. 

 Features 

 
 Smooth start – our Technical Solutions team will engage with your technical team to successfully set up your new translation integration. 
 Support for your global teams – our Customer Success Team will support you to deliver your translations accurately and quickly. 
 Global consistency of translation – ensure your brand voice is effectively applied across all your translated content. We work closely with your teams across all languages and geographies to develop linguistic assets that embody your brand voice and ensure consistent application across all content types and sources. 
 
 Requirements 

This module requires the TMGMT module to be installed. It also requires a username, a password, and a Project ID from your WordsOnline Translation Services account.

Please contact us for additional details and to set up your account.
